name: Cheesy Cauliflower Nacho Bites with Veggie Ground, Avocado & Yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (for easier cleanup).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Remove leaves and thick stems from each cauliflower head, then cut into bite-sized florets. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
Place cauliflower in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing once, until golden and fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground and spices; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, then remove from the heat.
While the veggie ground is cooking, small dice tomatoes and place on a large plate.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add to the plate with the tomato.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the plate.
Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Add to the plate.
When the cauliflower is done, top with an even layer of veggie ground and cheese. Return to the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and veggie ground is warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide cauliflower bites between plates; top with tomato, green onion, cilantro, avocado, lime wedges, and yogurt. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
